---
name: task-planning
description: "Decompose stories and design into executable tasks."
---
# Procedure

Create tasks.json with story/design references and acyclic dependencies. Separate source, configuration, SQL, integration, fixture, deployment and verification tasks when independently reviewable. Each task must state deliverable, observable completion and verification. State estimates as ranges with assumptions if requested.

# Contract

Read docs/STACK.md and the selected change inputs. Preserve source/requirement references. Persist outputs to changes/CHANGE-ID. Use templates where relevant. Do not modify controls or self-approve. Report blockers with the decision needed and affected artifacts.
